# Copilot instructions

Start with [`docs/developer-guide.md`](../docs/developer-guide.md) and follow
its rules.

Use the architecture ADR and the executable tests as the source of truth:

- [`docs/adr/0001-centralize-meetup-event-automation.md`](../docs/adr/0001-centralize-meetup-event-automation.md)
- [`tests/architecture.spec.ts`](../tests/architecture.spec.ts)
- [`tests/contracts.spec.ts`](../tests/contracts.spec.ts)

Prefer minimal, deterministic changes and keep documentation in sync with code.
